doc.title: Orrin Keepnews interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002

title: Explaining what a clip joint was
summary: Rowe asks what a clip joint is and Keepnews explains the overcharging 52nd Street clubs.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: That’s — are you asking me seriously?
Yeah I am. I don’t know the term.

Well it’s a joint at which you get clipped. It’s a — you are aware of the reputation of the 52nd Street ex-speakeasy night clubs, and swing street and such, where oh just possibly the drinks were a little watered, just possibly you were being overcharged. That’s — I’m sorry I’m using old fashioned—
No, I wanted to make sure what you were taking about.
